name: LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR
paste:
LANKO 751 LANKOLATEX SBR: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR, April 2026, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/lanko-751-lankolatexsbr.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR is a flexible SBR additive designed for use with Lanko, Davco and general mortar systems. LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR provides improved adhesive and compressive strength, water resistance and flexibility. It can also improve workability to make mortars easier to mix and place.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR may be used as an additive with Lanko cement based technical mortars, in particular mortars for screeding, rendering, patching and repair.
    - LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR can be used in conjunction with neat cement as a bonding coat prior to the application of any mortar system.
    - LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR can also be used as an additive for any of Davco’s range of cement based tile adhesives and grouts.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.8.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: SBR latex additive for cement mortar systems
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Water-resistant
    - Improved adhesive and compressive strength
    - Flexible
    - Ideal for screeding, rendering, patching and repairing with Davco Lanko cement based technical mortars
2.4 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5 L and 20 L
    - Shelf life: 12 months
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 4°C - 35°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - Surfaces, must be dry, structurally sound, clean, free of dust,dirt, wax, oil, grease, asphalt, mastic, latex compounds, adhesives, paint, gypsum-based products and other contaminants.
    - Ensure all release agents are removed from surface of concrete, especially tilt-up slabs.
    - Painted surfaces should be scabbled to expose at least 80% of the original surface.
    - Very porous surfaces must be primed with LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR as per instructions below.
    - New concrete must be allowed to cure for six weeks and have a wood float finish.
    - Steel trowel finished concrete must be acid etched or wire brushed prior to tiling.
    - Old concrete and rendered surfaces must be thoroughly cleaned prior to tiling.
    - Newly rendered surfaces must be allowed to cure for at least 7 days.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Mixing - Rendering Mix.
    - 1 part LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR • 4 parts water
    - 3:1 sand/cement mix
    Apply with a flat trowel onto the surface to be rendered.
4.3 Mixing - Priming and Sealing Mix.
    - 1 part LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR
    - 3 parts water
    Apply with a broom/brush onto the floor or wall.
4.4 Mixing - Concrete Patching Mix.
    - 1 part LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR • 4 parts water
    - 3:1 sand/cement mix
    Apply with a flat trowel or spatula to patch holes or depressions in concrete or rendered surfaces after priming.
4.5 Mixing - Joinery. Neat LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR can be used to bond timber to timber. Apply with a brush or roller.
4.6 Application. Refer to individual mortar datasheets for details on application techniques.
4.7 Cleaning of equipment. Clean up tools and equipment with water while LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR is still wet.
4.8 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not use LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR in temperatures above 40ºC and below 5ºC.
    - LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR is not recommended for the bonding of plastic or rubber.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.8):
    - Do not use LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR in temperatures above 40ºC and below 5ºC.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR, April 2026, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/lanko-751-lankolatexsbr.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: lanko 751 Lankolatex SBR, version 05/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/MSDS%20Lanko%20751%20Lankolatex%20SBR%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Various Semi-Finished, version 04/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sds-various-semi-finished-1.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS LANKO 751 Lankolatex SBR, version 04/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sds-lanko-751-lankolatexsbr.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
